title: Employee Duty Schedules — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
Assigns the employee to a roster duty schedule for a period. Schedules for the same employee cannot overlap.

It is recorded for reference; the time engine and payroll take the employee's duties from duty periods and substitute duties, and do not read this assignment at present.

fields.label: StartDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Its dates cannot overlap another record for the same employee.
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: EndDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Cannot be before the start date.
fields.html: What it is. The last day this record applies.

fields.label: RosterDutySchedule
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Roster Duty Schedule master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The roster duty schedule.

Example. Security Night Roster
